name: Auphonic
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Auphonic, normalize loudness, reduce noise, and batch-process user-owned audio locally. The hard boundary is proprietary adaptive audio processing, cloud queues, and broad format delivery, plus audio infrastructure, distribution, and production polish.
